title: Eurofighter Typhoon (Tranche 3A)

sources.title: JoyPro cockpit catalog (panels, items and grip functions of the variant)

intro: Tranche 3A is the newest batch of production Typhoons, built from 2014. From the outside and in the cockpit it is almost the same jet as the earlier tranches: three colour screens, a wide HUD (the glass screen in front of the pilot's eyes that shows flight numbers and aiming marks), a helmet display, a centre stick and two throttles full of buttons. The main change is the preparation for the new CAPTOR-E radar, which changes what the radar pages show but, as far as public sources tell, not the switches. So this guide follows the Tranche 1 cockpit.
